$comment: Defaults for every job. Override per job with jobs/<slug>/config.json (deep-merged). Keys and secrets never go here: they go in .env.

providers.$comment: SWAP ANY PROVIDER HERE. Each name is a file in providers/<kind>/<name>.mjs. --dry-run uses the 'dry' adapter of every kind. Env vars CF_LLM_PROVIDER / CF_TTS_PROVIDER / CF_MUSIC_PROVIDER / CF_CAPTIONS_PROVIDER / CF_PUBLISHER override for one run.
providers.$llm: dry | openai-compatible (hosted API, router, or a local server such as Ollama: the default base URL) | command (any CLI)
providers.$tts: dry | piper (free, local) | command (any TTS CLI)
providers.$visuals: maps each script visual.source to an adapter: dry | folder | pexels | openai-images | command
providers.$music: dry | none | strudel-command (default engine, your own renderer) | wav-folder | file | command (other engines or an AI music API)
providers.$musicFallback: used when the music adapter is not set up yet (for example no Strudel renderer installed); "none" to fail instead
providers.$captions: dry | even-split (free, local) | command (any aligner / speech-to-text that outputs word times)
providers.$publisher: dry (default: never posts, only prints what it would send) | upload-post (paid API, keys in .env) | your own adapter (copy providers/publisher/template.mjs). Used by `node factory.mjs publish run` AFTER a human approves.

script.ctaHint: a short, honest call to action

visuals.$spendCapUsd: per-run cap for paid visual calls. 0 = no paid calls at all.
visuals.$prices: USD per call for paid adapters. null = unknown, so paid calls are refused. Check your provider's current pricing.

handoff.$comment: Step 9 adds the finished video to the publish queue as a DRAFT with these defaults. A human previews and approves it.

publish.$comment: The publish queue and its approval gate. Paths are relative to the repo root. Env CF_PUBLISH_QUEUE / CF_PUBLISH_STATS / CF_PUBLISH_LOG_FILE override.

upload-post.$comment: Non-secret Upload-Post options. UPLOAD_POST_API_KEY and UPLOAD_POST_USER go in .env. An UPLOAD_POST_* env var overrides each option.
upload-post.$aiLabel: true = mark posts as AI-generated where the platform supports it. Keep it on when the voice or visuals are synthetic.
upload-post.$tiktokPrivacy: e.g. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE or SELF_ONLY; empty = the account default
